title: Pipeline Schema
description: Defines a minimal pipeline configuration model that the infra package expects for creating CodePipeline/CodeBuild resources.

name.description: Logical name for the pipeline (eg. web-cicd)

branch.description: Git branch the pipeline will build and deploy

stage.description: SST stage to deploy (eg. dev, production)

buildSpecPath.description: Path (in repo) to a buildspec file used by CodeBuild
